title: The upload review's bulk value saves carry no erase: they ride on the store's erase mark
evidence: Done 2026-11-25 (R5 PR 2): the upload no longer calls bulkSave*; it saves through saveUploadThrough (storage/upload-save-store.ts), which now writes under the erase the flow's saving state carries: useUploadFlow's save reads getShownErase() at the press on Save and sends it on saveStarted (health-core upload-flow.ts saving.erase, upload-schema.ts; the phone's door omits it, ios/engine/upload-doors.ts). The one live bulk caller, the blood pressure widget (BloodPressure.tsx save -> savePair -> bulkSaveMeasurements(rows, erase)), reads the erase as the save is asked. bulkSaveLabValues and bulkSaveDocuments had no production caller and left the store and the data layer; a word-for-word copy stays in widget-src/src/testing/bulk-save.ts for the tests that still call them (list for Brad in the PR). Tests: roadmap-store-upload-save.test.ts 'US-16 AC2a: the Save writes under the erase its state carries', roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts bulkSaveMeasurements row, BloodPressure.test.tsx 'US-16 AC2a', useUploadFlow.send-live.test.tsx, upload-flow.save-failed.test.ts; the upload and bulk rows failed before the fix. Left for PR 3: the argument required by type, then the store mark goes. Was: storage/roadmap-store.ts:387 and :395 refuses() with no erase, :412 bulkSave edits with none R5 PR 3 (2026-11-25): the erase is a required argument by type on every RoadmapStore and lib/roadmap-data.ts writer, on RecordSession.refuses and .edit (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts: the fallback default `erase = this.shownErase` is gone), and on the web upload Save's state (storage/upload-save-store.ts WebSaving; the phone's door still omits it). A writer that forgets it does not compile: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts `writersRequireAnErase` (one @ts-expect-error per writer) and its table (each writer under an older erase refused, record JSON unchanged; under the shown erase it lands).
